purpose: Frozen upstream source and custody record for SKGateway qualification. No provider secrets, tokens, or literal private addresses appear here.

upstream.vendoring_decision: Do not vendor the upstream checkout into SKLegal unless a later source and maintenance decision explicitly requires it.

dependency_audit.planning_observation: The planning checkout installed js-yaml@4.1.1; npm audit --omit=dev reported one high-severity YAML denial-of-service advisory set.
dependency_audit.gate: Clear the high-severity advisory through a pinned, tested upstream source or a reviewed lockfile update. Do not apply an unreviewed blanket audit fix. Rerun the full gateway suite before deployment.
dependency_audit.reviewed_lockfile_update: js-yaml 5.3.0, exact version pin, tested against upstream commit b4b4115df9a6d5c9c4621d98207a1074e2737ef5
dependency_audit.qualified_audit: npm audit --omit=dev: 0 info, 0 low, 0 moderate, 0 high, 0 critical

live_path_gate.requirement: Prove every control on the exact deployed commit's production routeAndSend entrypoint. A control that exists only in an alternate library path or the test suite does not satisfy the gate.
live_path_gate.protected_traffic: denied until the gate passes and a human approves activation

secrets.sklegal_side: Store only secret references and environment variable names. Runtime values use an owner-only 0600 EnvironmentFile or stronger injection.
secrets.skgateway_side: Provider API keys are optional, added one at a time by the human owner through the approved secret-management workflow, and never pasted into a shell command, shell history, systemd unit, repository, prompt, log, test fixture, dashboard, or completion evidence.
secrets.network: Bind the proxy and dashboard to the narrowest interface. Remote access requires authenticated TLS and network policy.
